stories.title: Kalam to Mahodand by road
stories.note: Waypoints are the sourced places in the upper pack; the camera follows the jeep and 4WD road between them.

stops.name: Kalam
stops.caption: It lies 99 km north of Mingora at about 2,000 m.

stops.name: Matiltan
stops.caption: It is reached by a non-metalled road in a four-wheel drive vehicle.

stops.name: Ushu (Usho)
stops.caption: The Ushu glacier blocks the only path to Mahodand in winter. It is known for its cloudy, rainy forest.

stops.name: Mahodand Lake
stops.caption: It lies about 40 km from Kalam in the Usho sub-valley. Elevation about 2,865 m.

stories.title: Mingora to Bahrain by road
stories.note: Mingora is in the lower pack, so this story stays inside it. Kalam and Mahodand are in the upper pack (see kalam-to-mahodand).

stops.name: Mingora
stops.caption: Mingora is the largest city of Malakand Division.

stops.name: Khwazakhela
stops.caption: Second-largest commercial centre in Swat. Draws people from Kalam, Kohistan and Shangla.

stops.name: Bahrain (Behrain)
stops.caption: The name means 'two rivers' for the Daral/Swat confluence. It is a base camp for the Daral and Saidgai lakes trail.
